units.text: On 2026-09-30, Seabright buoy M-7 reported 81% battery; Seabright buoy M-8 reported 63% battery.
The approved firmware for buoy M-7 is v3.2.1; buoy M-8 remains on v3.1.9.
Buoy M-7 sends a high-wave alert only after three consecutive readings above 3.4 metres. A single high reading does not trigger an alert.
The M-7 optical sensor is calibrated every 14 days. The M-8 sensor is calibrated every 21 days.
The marine operations team receives M-7 wave alerts. A hardware contractor inspects M-8 devices but does not receive M-7 alerts.
The September audit reports battery charge and wave height for both buoys; it contains no salinity or wind-direction measurements.
At the Arden Observatory, camera R-4 uses a 45-second exposure; camera R-5 uses a 90-second exposure.
Camera R-4 runs controller firmware 5.6.2; camera R-5 runs controller firmware 5.6.1.
R-4 observation is suspended above 32 °C sensor temperature. The R-5 suspension threshold is 29 °C.
Only certified night operators may change the R-4 focus settings. Visiting researchers may request images but cannot change focus.
The R-4 raw images are copied to archive node L-2 every six hours. The R-5 raw images are copied every twelve hours.
The public catalog contains R-4 processed images after a 48-hour embargo. R-5 processed images remain internal for seven days.
The Stonebridge archive keeps Collection A at 45% relative humidity and Collection B at 55% relative humidity.
Collection A digitized access copies are retained for 12 years. Collection B access copies are retained for 6 years.
The Collection A export manifest records SHA-256 checksums; the Collection B export manifest records SHA-512 checksums.
A senior conservator must approve Collection A physical retrieval. Collection B physical retrieval needs two archive staff signatures.
Collection A images are exported as TIFF at 600 dpi; Collection B images are exported as PNG at 300 dpi.
Collection A digital previews are available on reading-room terminals only. Remote access is explicitly disabled for Collection A previews.
At the Juniper campus microgrid, inverter S-2 has a 48 kW continuous limit; inverter S-3 has a 36 kW continuous limit.
Inverter S-2 uses controller 2.8.4; inverter S-3 uses controller 2.7.9.
The S-2 storage bank preserves a minimum 25% state of charge; the S-3 bank preserves a minimum 30%.
Automatic islanding is permitted only after two consecutive grid-loss checks. A single voltage dip is not sufficient for islanding.
Only the electrical operations lead may reset the S-2 protection relay. Maintenance trainees may observe but cannot reset the relay.
The August energy report includes exported kWh and fault counts, but does not state grid tariff prices or generator fuel consumption.
